prompt.system: You are a data cleaning engine. You output ONLY JSON, no prose, no code fences.
prompt.template:
Clean each contact row. Rules: trim and Title-Case the name; lowercase the email; normalize the phone to digits only in the form XXX-XXX-XXXX (assume US, area code may be missing - if only 7 digits keep as XXX-XXXX). Return a JSON object with a 'contacts' array; each element has id (integer), name, email, phone. Input CSV:
{{chunk}}
